net.conclusion: Every unit-square orientation contains a concentric B-core at a net angle strictly in its interior.
net.remaining: Every admissible centre at every net angle must have mixed score >= Gamma, and M < n*Gamma. Not checked here.

theorem: No packing of n closed unit squares in the closed square of side L: choose disjoint interior closed cores at net angles; each has measure >=1 but total measure <n.
